evidence: ALD depositions of tin oxide onto AAO were carried out by using Picosun R-200 ALD tool set up for the single wafer depositions. Deposition temperature was kept constant at 225 °C. TDMASn was evaporated from Picohot 300 hot source held at 50 °C. H2O2 was kept at 20 °C to obtain surface sufficient vapor pressure. Typical ALD deposition cycle was consisting of TDMASn pulse/dwell/purge/H2O2 pulse/dwell/purge with times of 3 s/0 –14 s/9 s/0.3 s/0–14 s/9 s timing, respectively.
